issues.description: README StorageError.handle parameter order change is undocumented and likely wrong
issues.detail: README reorders handle(ex, req, resp, params) to handle(req, resp, ex, params) with no commit-message justification or versionchanged note. Either it contradicts Falcon's documented add_error_handler contract, or it is an undocumented API alignment. Readers copying the snippet will hit a signature mismatch. Justify in the commit, add a versionchanged directive, or drop the change.

issues.description: Swap from req.stream to req.bounded_stream in the example is a silent contract change
issues.detail: JSONTranslator now reads req.bounded_stream instead of req.stream with no comment, docstring, or versionchanged note. The two are not substitutable: bounded_stream enforces Content-Length and changes behavior on malformed or chunked bodies. The PR description claims a different change. Document the rationale and the invariant being preserved.

issues.description: FAQ example reads req.content_length bytes unbounded and obscures the actual invariant
issues.detail: PostTest.on_post calls req.stream.read(req.content_length or 0) with a client-supplied length, which is a copy-paste foot-gun (unbounded allocation). The example also proves 'read() returned falsy' while the prose claims 'non-zero Content-Length with empty body returns 400.' State the invariant explicitly and bound the read, or use bounded_stream.

issues.description: FAQ example has style problems unfit for canonical documentation
issues.detail: Uses parenthesized `assert(result.status == ...)` which trains readers toward the always-truthy tuple form, has nested if/else where flat branches would read cleaner, an unused `import falcon`, and a trailing comma in the headers list. FAQ code is copied verbatim by newcomers; tighten before merging.

issues.description: New POST tests assert status codes without naming the contract under test
issues.detail: resp3 (201) and resp4 (400) have no docstring or comment stating the invariant ('POST with valid JSON body succeeds'; 'POST with empty body but non-zero Content-Length is rejected'). Future maintainers cannot tell whether 400 is the spec or an accident of bounded_stream behavior. Add a one-line spec comment per assertion block.

issues.description: PR bundles unrelated changes — tests, README reformat, FAQ entry — should be split
issues.detail: Stated goal is adding POST tests, but the diff also rewrites the README example (signature change, str.format conversion, style reformatting) and adds an FAQ section. Reviewing the substantive test change is buried under reformatting noise. Land the test PR cleanly and resubmit the README and FAQ changes as separate diffs with their own justifications.

synthesis.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The panel agrees the test additions are useful but the PR is under-audited and bundles unrelated changes. The two contract-touching edits — the README StorageError.handle parameter reorder and the req.stream→req.bounded_stream swap in the middleware example — are undocumented, unexplained in the commit message, and inconsistent with the PR description. The new FAQ example contains unbounded read patterns and style issues unsuitable for canonical docs, and the new tests assert status codes without naming the invariants they protect. Split the PR, document the contract changes, and tighten the FAQ example before merge.
